svg.title: Samvriti.Space — The Glass
svg.desc: One unbroken line draws a cutting-chai glass and what comes off it. It starts as a loose lip at the left rim, goes down the wall, across the base, and up the far wall — and at the rim it does not stop: the same stroke lifts off as steam, wavers twice, and winds into a close, still coil above the glass. The vessel and the thing it gives off are one line; the only part of it that holds anything is open at the top. A session at this practice is an hour at home, on a screen, with something hot going cold beside the laptop. One path, one M, no Z.
